# Parley v0.1.61

This unnotarized test beta fixes a hang after the Mac wakes from sleep, and
includes the fixes from the 22 September repository review merged since
v0.1.60.

## Restart agent panes after updating

The agent protocol is now version 33. Agent panes started under v0.1.60 show
**RESTART FOR PROTOCOL** until you restart them; restart each when it is
convenient. Codex panes in particular need the restart to receive the
protocol correctly (see below).

## Hang after sleep and wake

- v0.1.60 could freeze shortly after the Mac woke, and had to be
  force-quit. Ghostty's renderer stopped its display link while holding the
  lock the main thread needs to draw, and that stop can stall around sleep
  and wake. This is Ghostty issue 14150, fixed upstream; Parley now embeds
  libghostty-spm 1.6.20260922 (Ghostty 3c47ca15), which carries the fix.

## Agents and handoffs

- Codex panes received Parley's protocol as one escaped line because the
  launch values were written as JSON rather than TOML. They are now valid
  TOML and arrive as written.
- A delegation's prompt names its own id, and reports must use it:
  `parley done <id>`, `fail`, `progress` and `done --file`. A report naming a
  delegation that has closed is refused with its state, and `current` is
  refused after a delegation to that pane was cancelled, so a late report can
  no longer complete the next delegation with the wrong result.
- Long messages are no longer silently cut. Text over 100,000 characters is
  refused with its real length and nothing is sent; the composer shows the
  count.
- Many waiting `parley wait` commands can no longer starve the relay, so a
  worker's `parley done` always goes through.
- Retry Delivery and adding a capture to an agent's context draft no longer
  freeze the window while they reach a pane.
- A reviewed Ask you write keeps its draft until Parley accepts it. If the
  target was busy, the draft comes back; if delivery may have started, you
  are told so and offered a copy instead of a resend.
- Sending to another pane no longer moves you onto it. Only Copilot's
  submission briefly borrows focus, and it is handed back to the pane or
  text field you were using.
- When a CLI exits (after `/exit`, or when it is missing from PATH), its
  pane now reads exited within about a second, and relay to it stops.
- New Claude, Codex, Agy, Shell and Copilot Pane moved to Option-Command-1
  to 5. Shift-Command-3, 4 and 5 are macOS screenshot shortcuts, so three of
  the old ones never reached Parley.

## Safety

- Parley's own Git reads (delegation facts, pane context, the Worktrees
  window, previews and context diffs) can no longer run programs a
  repository's configuration names, such as filters or an external diff.
  Parley records no Git facts for a container pane's delegations.
- An approved command runs without the pane's terminal. A command that asks
  for input, such as git asking for a username, now fails and says so
  instead of waiting for a day, and anything typed meanwhile is discarded
  rather than run by the Shell afterwards. Run such commands yourself in a
  Shell.
- Worktree cleanup refuses when it cannot see the work it would delete:
  edits to files marked assume-unchanged or skip-worktree, and trees with a
  checked-out submodule. Prune previews Git's own dry run and refuses while
  any entry's folder may still be in use. Delete branch follows Git's rule
  for a branch with an upstream and deletes only the commit you saw. Trees
  holding node_modules or .build can now be checked and removed.
- Integrate merges the branch even when a tag has the same name.
- A saved layout reopens with the automation policy it was saved with, and a
  restore or workspace close that cannot complete changes nothing.
- A team's container member can no longer appear twice in a layout (one
  copy drew blank).

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the deterministic checks, repository scans,
the app build, the 25-round Ghostty soak, packaging, checksums and
packaged-launch verification before publishing this beta.

The sleep-and-wake hang cannot be reproduced on demand; the fix is Ghostty's
own, and the evidence is the matching hang report. The following were
checked in code and automated checks but not by hand in the app: `/exit` in
a real vendor pane, a `git push` over HTTPS from an approved run, and the
Worktrees window's prune and removal flows.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
